notes: vintage and retrieved are different kinds of fact. 'vintage' is what the data depicts -- WRI release 1.3.0, whose reported generation columns run through 2019. 'retrieved' is when these bytes were obtained. Only the first is a freshness authority; presenting the second as one is the error this repository's freshness model exists to prevent.

This repository intentionally vendors one immutable reference snapshot for reproducibility. It is NOT a cache and is not expected to update in place. Adopting a future WRI release means a new explicit dataset-version commit, not a silent replacement of this file.

'retrieved' is carried over from the derived grid at research/lattice_board/data/energy_world.json, whose provenance block documents this exact CSV (34,936 plants, 'grid recomputed from the canonical CSV'). It is not independently attested here.

sha256 is of the COMMITTED bytes. The repository's `* text=auto` rule normalises line endings, so a hash taken from a local working copy is not what a clone receives -- the first declaration recorded a CRLF working file (11,973,385 bytes) while git stored LF (11,938,448). This file is pinned `-text` in .gitattributes so the declared hash is reproducible on every platform.
